title: Gallatin AI raises $50M in funding for its military logistics platform
description: Gallatin AI Inc., a developer of military logistics software, today announced that it has raised $50 million in funding. The Series A round included contributions from 8VC, Silent Ventures and several others. It follows a $15 million seed raise in 2024.
